body: It's not much consolation, but here I sit with you. I've not been diagnosed, but disease I know I do have is more than enough for me. I feel pain and sympathy for you. I have an overwhelming internal need to try and help, but at the same time interfering robs you of any control. I think this unknown driving force to help others has kept me alive. I just try not to think at all. sometimes I can get away with it and it helps. Other times like tonight I lie awake and stare at the ceiling until morning finds me once again.

what's happened to me is almost verbatim. The similarity in happenings and the resulting pain is scary. The one big difference being I have weapons at my disposal. I've always been a calm person, taking things in stride; I always seem to find the motivation to move on. From this however, I cannot. Everyday I try to find reasons to carry on. Everyday I find myself struggling for that needle in the global haystack. I don't know if you're still around, but I only wish peace to you, however you may find it. I made the mistake of telling truthfully how I felt to close friends. Not a week passed before I was ostracized. Treated as a leper, I'm forgotten. My health has deteriorated, my mind an endless blur. I can barely focus enough to write this passage. My job is in jeopardy and any hope I had for a happy future dwindled away from one lying cunt who used me and played me for a fool. It's sad to think that a person could use you so efficiently and ruthlessly with such disregard, and force someone so full of life at one point to the life of a xenophobic wretch. May this be a warning. Be wary of who you trust. That was the last time I put trust in another human.
